title: Offscreen render passes declare only an incoming dependency; the final-layout transition and attachment writes are not ordered before the next pass samples them
expected_finding: sky_pass and bloom_pass have no subpass 0 -> EXTERNAL dependency: bloom_downsample samples sky_color and tonemap samples sky_color/bloom_downsample with no ordering after the attachment writes and the final transition to SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL (read-after-write); the incoming dependency's first scope (FRAGMENT_SHADER / SHADER_READ) does not cover the previous frame's attachment writes, so the DONT_CARE load races them (write-after-write)
